briefing.title: Prepare for the 9 December raid unlock
briefing.summary: Blizzard has announced three level-60 raids: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia’s Lair. Check entry requirements before choosing what to prepare.
briefing.label: Plan dungeons and raids

briefing.title: Dungeon resets capped at five per hour
briefing.summary: Factor the per-dungeon limit into repeat runs for gear, cloth or reputation. Have a second activity in mind if you are clearing quickly.
briefing.label: Explore dungeon options

briefing.title: Recheck Destruction and Shadow before testing a build
briefing.summary: Blizzard fixed Intensity with Incinerate and corrected two Shadow Priest interactions involving Dark Inspiration and Chastise.
briefing.label: Compare class builds

warrior/arms.title: Check your two-hander
warrior/arms.detail: Practise Sweeping Strikes on pairs and set Mortal Strike on the bar if you have reached it. Keep your shield set for contested travel.

warrior/fury.title: Make Bloodthirst sustainable
warrior/fury.detail: On repeated pulls, compare Rage and downtime with your current two weapons before making talent changes.

warrior/protection.title: Test Shield Slam on a mixed pack
warrior/protection.detail: Bring a current shield. Mark a caster and see which target you need to interrupt or taunt after the opening.

paladin/holy.title: Plan Light’s Vigil
paladin/holy.detail: Try the capstone on a dungeon pull with real group damage. Pack a damage set if the next route will be solo.

paladin/protection.title: Start with a shield pull
paladin/protection.detail: Use a corner for casters and check whether threat or incoming damage is the thing limiting the next pull.

paladin/retribution.title: Try the Seal-switching capstone
paladin/retribution.detail: Compare an ordinary two-handed pull with a longer fight where Unsealed Wrath has time to work.

hunter/beast-mastery.title: Have the pet ready for Bestial Wrath
hunter/beast-mastery.detail: Check its relevant attack, defensive and control skills before changing the build for tougher targets.

hunter/marksmanship.title: Test Sniper Shot from cover
hunter/marksmanship.detail: Compare pet and Lone Wolf pulls. Count how often your pet holds a mob long enough to get another shot away.

hunter/survival.title: Plan where to drop a trap
hunter/survival.detail: Practise on one durable mob and a short pack before trying the same melee weaving in a dungeon.

rogue/assassination.title: Check daggers and poison supply
rogue/assassination.detail: Try the Mutilate and Venom setup on a quest elite and decide which parts are worth using on ordinary mobs.

rogue/combat.title: Fit Adrenaline Rush to a long pull
rogue/combat.detail: Save it for a pull where you can stay in melee, with Blade Flurry ready if two targets can be hit safely.

rogue/subtlety.title: Try Death Mark on a durable target
rogue/subtlety.detail: Leave time for the damage window. Keep a control or reset tool available for players joining the fight.

priest/discipline.title: Take stock of your healing role
priest/discipline.detail: At 36, keep Penance if you heal regularly. Decide whether the next allocation will cover solo damage or a second group-healing style.

priest/discipline.title: Compare the endgame allocations
priest/discipline.detail: Open the full talent comparison before spending points. Check the rotation in a dungeon and keep the outdoor allocation if it has been useful on contested routes.

priest/holy.title: Plan your next healing tool
priest/holy.detail: At 36, practise Binding Heal and Prayer of Healing. Aim for Prayer of Mending at 40 if you stay deep Holy.

priest/holy.title: Compare the endgame allocations
priest/holy.detail: Open the full talent comparison before spending points. Check the rotation in a dungeon and keep the outdoor allocation if it has been useful on contested routes.

priest/shadow.title: Count the points to Shadowform
priest/shadow.detail: At 36, normal progression gives 27 points. Four more get you to 31 at 40 if they are all in Shadow. Plan a respec only if a dip would delay it.

priest/shadow.title: Compare the endgame allocations
priest/shadow.detail: Open the full talent comparison before spending points. Check the rotation in a dungeon and keep the outdoor allocation if it has been useful on contested routes.

shaman/elemental.title: Build around lightning
shaman/elemental.detail: Set up Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and shocks on the bar and check the current name and effect of Lightning Mastery.

shaman/enhancement.title: Match Stormstrike to your gear
shaman/enhancement.detail: Look at the actual weapon you have and practise keeping Windfury and your useful totems in play on successive pulls.

shaman/restoration.title: Try Chain Heal in a real group
shaman/restoration.detail: Check where allies stand in your usual groups and use Riptide when you have to move.

mage/arcane.title: Plan one burn window
mage/arcane.detail: Try Arcane Power on a durable target and check the mana left when you start the next pull.

mage/fire.title: Prepare a Fire cooldown pull
mage/fire.detail: Use Combustion on a target with enough health to use it. Check how much time you spend drinking between fights.

mage/frost.title: Plan control before the pull
mage/frost.detail: Use a small pack to practise Ice Barrier, freezes and a route to cover. Save an escape if you are outdoors.

druid/balance.title: Learn the Moonkin cast rhythm
druid/balance.detail: Use a durable target to practise Wrath into Eclipse-accelerated Starfire and see when rolling DoTs are worth it.

druid/feral.title: Choose the Cat or Bear capstone
druid/feral.detail: Train Dire Bear. Choose Shifting Power for Cat or Primal Bite for Bear, then pick the gear and pulls for that job.

druid/restoration.title: Learn where Wild Growth fits
druid/restoration.detail: Try it in a dungeon when several allies will benefit and the incoming damage allows a stationary cast.

warlock/affliction.title: Decide whether to rush Wrack
warlock/affliction.detail: At 44 you can have Wrack on a deep path. If you already have a sustain dip, compare how many pulls actually let you finish the channel before paying for a respec.

warlock/affliction.title: Compare the endgame allocations
warlock/affliction.detail: Open the full talent comparison before spending points. Check the rotation in a dungeon and keep the outdoor allocation if it has been useful on contested routes.

warlock/demonology.title: Make your demon swap deliberate
warlock/demonology.detail: At 44 you can have Demonic Pact. Try a sustain sacrifice and summon a different demon before a long quest route.

warlock/demonology.title: Compare the endgame allocations
warlock/demonology.detail: Open the full talent comparison before spending points. Check the rotation in a dungeon and keep the outdoor allocation if it has been useful on contested routes.

warlock/destruction.title: Try a short Incinerate pull
warlock/destruction.detail: At 44, check which mobs live long enough for Immolate into Incinerate. Save Havoc for a second target worth the global.

warlock/destruction.title: Compare the endgame allocations
warlock/destruction.detail: Open the full talent comparison before spending points. Check the rotation in a dungeon and keep the outdoor allocation if it has been useful on contested routes.

tailoring.title: Price silk and the glove route
tailoring.detail: Check whether your silk stock and the cost of elixirs favour the next gloves before buying Mageweave in bulk.

tailoring.title: Compare Mageweave cloth with bolts
tailoring.detail: Price the material per bolt and keep cloth for recipes that call for it directly. Check the next skill band before converting your entire stock.

tailoring.title: Plan Artisan training
tailoring.detail: Check the rank’s character-level requirement and trainer before spending on the next cloth tier.

tailoring.title: Check Runecloth and recipe access
tailoring.detail: Buy the next band only after checking your training, pattern access and the route’s skill-up uncertainty.
